line.comment: * Warning! All squadrons are built from an original M3; it is therefore important that all templates have at least 1 M3.
* Zero Hour 1.9 - Teladi ships are weaker but their fleets larger
* Zero Hour 1.9 - Terran ships are stronger but their fleets smaller
* ZH 2.0 - Terrans always were a bit too weak due to having fewer but strong ships. Added some bigger fleet templates which can randomly increase their overall power
* ZH 2.0 - if player decides to betray Phanon they unlock new Battleships and use more heavy designs
* ZH 2.0 - if player decides to betray Phanon they unlock new Battleships and use more heavy designs
* M4's are chosen for followers because they should be faster than the leader and able to keep up. Otherwise, all m3's the leader gets ahead and that fails.
* Either way, the slowest ship is always chosen to lead a 'raider' squadron.
* Add-Ons 2.2: Increased M3 and M4 count (2 M3 -> 3 M3, 8 M4 -> 9 M4) to get 1 dozen.
